newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Auto says has five model strategy.
newsitem.headline: Saab Auto says has five model strategy.

text.p: Swedish car maker Saab Auto said on Thursday that it has a strategy to have five different models of car on the market in the future.
"We have a five car strategy for the future," Saab Auto Chief Executive Robert Hendry told a news conference.
"What that means in terms of the number of (manufacturing) platforms we will need is however uncertain. Maybe it will be enough with the two we have today, maybe a third will be needed."
The five segments of the car market that Saab Auto has identified as most interesting are all in what is called the "premium cars" segment.
